dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.text: WKU IT Help Desk, good morning. You're speaking with Daniyar. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Oh thank goodness! I've been trying to call for twenty minutes. My laptop stopped working completely and I need to submit my programming assignment in two hours!

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.text: I understand — that sounds very stressful. Let's try to fix it together. First, can you tell me what exactly is happening?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: The screen just went black. No warning, nothing. I can hear it running but the display is completely dead.

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.text: OK. First, try pressing and holding the power button for ten seconds to force a restart. Do that now, please.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Done... the screen is flickering a bit. Wait — something is happening! I can see the desktop background now.

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.text: Great! Now, before you do anything else, immediately save all your work to a cloud service — Google Drive or OneDrive.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I'm doing it now... uploading to Google Drive. OK, it's saved. What was the problem?

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.text: Probably a graphics driver crash. It often happens after a Windows update. Now, do you have a stable internet connection?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: That's the other problem! My Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting every few minutes. I need it for the submission portal.

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.text: Try this: forget the current Wi-Fi network, then reconnect. Sometimes the IP address conflicts. Can you do that?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Just a second... OK, I've forgotten the network and reconnected. The connection seems more stable now!

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.text: Perfect. If it disconnects again, use your phone as a mobile hotspot as a backup — that's the safest option for submissions.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Brilliant idea! I didn't think of that. You've saved my academic career today, Daniyar!

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.text: Happy to help! One more thing — I'd recommend visiting the IT office this week to update your graphics driver properly.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I will, I promise. Thank you so much — you're literally a lifesaver!
